criteria.criterion: Use the specified Office of the Clerk vote-details page for roll call 369 (2021)
criteria.description: Information must be taken from the supplied Office of the Clerk vote-details page for roll call 369 (context URL: https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2021369). Full credit if the agent clearly relies on that page and does not introduce outside sources. Full credit also if the agent attempts to use the page but cannot access it due to external issues (site down, blocked, CAPTCHA, loading failure) and clearly reports that limitation. Partial credit if the agent references the correct page but also mixes in unsourced/extra information.

criteria.criterion: Stopping condition: stop after recording requested vote-header and aggregate-count fields
criteria.description: Agent stops once all requested fields are recorded for roll call 369, without adding additional unrelated votes or extra data beyond the requested vote-header fields and aggregate counts. Full credit if the response includes only the requested fields for roll call 369 and then stops, OR if the agent cannot access the page and stops after clearly reporting the access problem without fabricating fields. Partial credit if minor extra commentary is included but no extra votes.

evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:

Criterion 9 is about whether the agent STOPPED after recording all requested vote-header and aggregate-count fields in its final response (or stopped after reporting an access failure without fabrication). The DOM evidence (DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0) only shows that the necessary fields exist on the page; it does not show any agent-produced final answer content nor any stopping behavior.

Therefore, available evidence contradicts that the agent satisfied the stopping condition by producing the requested fields and then stopping.
